items.name: Kael
items.description: An entity with internal integration between 'Alters' and potential external connections that AEGIS perceives as threatening. Character who deliberately performs actions to be monitored by AEGIS and investigates the surveillance system. A character who observes and interacts with AEGIS, attempting to understand its nature. Main character who demonstrates growth and overcomes a Guardian through integration and understanding. Character associated with AEGIS who may communicate or coordinate with Juna/V. Character who observes new phenomena in the unstable environment after AEGIS's fall and experiences creative flourishing; the character whose journey of understanding and confrontation is central to the narrative
